content: DMN 1.5 defines 7 hit policies: U(nique)=at most one match (overlap is error), A(ny)=overlap allowed if all matches agree else error, P(riority)=pick by allowed-values list order (rule order irrelevant), F(irst)=top-down first match wins (rule order significant), C(ollect)=all matches as unordered list, R(ule Order)=all matches in table row order, O(utput Order)=all matches sorted by output allowed-values priority. Collect aggregators: C+/SUM, C</MIN, C>/MAX, C#/COUNT (count ignores output values). Aggregated collect has single output column and returns scalar. No-match returns default output if configured else null (Collect does NOT implicitly return empty list). Open issue DMN15-31: sum-of-distinct-outputs semantics deferred to 1.6; sum([]) undefined.
